an7.24:1.1: satta vo bhikkhave aparihāniye dhamme desessāmi
an7.24:1.3: katame ca bhikkhave satta aparihāniyā dhammā
an7.24:2.1: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave bhikkhū na kammārāmā bhavissanti na kammārāmataṃ anuyuttā vuḍḍhiyeva bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni.
an7.24:3.1: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave bhikkhū na bhassārāmā bhavissanti …pe…
an7.24:3.4: na pāpicchā bhavissanti na pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃgatā
an7.24:3.5: na pāpamittā bhavissanti na pāpasahāyā na pāpasampavaṅkā
an7.24:3.6: na oramattakena visesādhigamena antarā vosānaṃ āpajjissanti vuḍḍhiyeva bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni.
an7.24:4.1: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave ime satta aparihāniyā dhammā bhikkhūsu ṭhassanti imesu ca sattasu aparihāniyesu dhammesu bhikkhū sandississanti vuḍḍhiyeva bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihānīti.
